title: Masked next-token loss, packing, and rejection sampling
brief: Compute the supervised fine-tuning loss with a prompt mask and a one-token shift, pack examples behind a block-diagonal mask, and keep the top samples per prompt.
hints: sft_loss scores tokens[:, 1:] from logits[:, :-1, :]. A term stays only when prompt_mask on that next token is 0. Return the sum, in float64.
The last prompt position predicts the first response token, so its logits keep a gradient. Zero the targets, not the positions.
pack_sequences restarts position ids at 0 and puts a causal triangle in each example's block. A single tril over the whole row lets attention cross the boundary.
rejection_sample_filter ranks inside each prompt id. On a tie, the smaller index wins. Weights of 0 or 1 then match sft_loss on the kept rows; the raw rewards do not.
